verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes API/SDK operations (add, search hybrid, update via customId, delete via container tag) and an official MCP server that lets an agent invoke these tools mid-conversation without pre-configured tool names ('Ask naturally... selects the right Supermemory tool'). This directly matches the story of an agent managing its own memory via tool/API calls. missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence of an agent autonomously invoking delete via MCP, and no explicit example combining add/search/update/delete in one live agent session.
